senses.gloss: thorn; pin, nail, v. סִכְּתָא.—[Yalk. Koh. 971 ס׳ למיעבד חבלא, read: סִיבָּא; ib. ס׳ למסמך ביה גופנין, v. סִיגָא.—
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>, beg. <he>סיכא</he> some ed., read <cite ref="O00526"><he>סִיבָּא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="O00898"><he>סִכִּין</he></cite>, <he>סִכַּיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="O00893"><he>סִכֵּי</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00067"><he>סִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Targ. Esth. V, 14</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 38:20">Targ. O. Ex. XXXVIII, 20</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:4">Mic. VII, 4</cite>) <he>ישרא דבהון כאילין ס׳</he> (ed. Krot. <cite ref="O00913"><he>סוּכַּ׳</he></cite>) the upright among them is like those thorns.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ סיכי</he>; a. e., v. <cite ref="O00945"><he>סִכְּתָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: ס׳ דפדן (or סַכִּין) (or ס׳ only) coulter of the plough (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Culter).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8:9">Num. R. s. 8</cite> <he>יהב ביה סכין דפ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="O00921"><he>סכן</he></cite>, corr. acc.) he (the Caesar) has a coulter put into him (orders him to be stabbed); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 24:1">Pesik. R. s. 23-24</cite> <he>מכה דפ׳</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 4:3">Targ. Mic. IV, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 2:4">Targ. Is. II, 4</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>סַכִּינִין</he>).
